mentions.name: Heaven.dev
mentions.description: A cloud platform offering completely persistent Linux computers that share a pooled group of resources (CPU, RAM, storage), so resources can be allocated flexibly across workloads. Built around the principle of "transmutability," where computers and resources can be shaped to match any workload, with particular benefits for working with AI coding agents.
mentions.problem: Current cloud infrastructure is extremely restrictive with the new tasks and ways of working that coding agents open.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a cloud where you get completely persistent Linux computers that share a group of resources (CPU, RAM, Storage). This means that you're able to allocate resources across workloads which has a ton of benefits when working with agents.
mentions.author: idoma
